result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but there is a stuck loading spinner overlaying the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image, which appears as a broken/pending image load. A few minor items were also noted.

issues.description: A loading spinner is stuck in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image, indicating the image failed to load or the loading state never resolved.
issues.suggestion: Check image loading/error handling for the card; add a timeout fallback and display a placeholder image if loading fails.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional horizontal carousel behavior, but consider adding a visual affordance (e.g., partial peek with clear scrollability) so users know more cards exist.

issues.description: The notification bell has a red dot indicator, but there is no visible count or accessible label describing the unread notifications.
issues.suggestion: Add a content description or badge count (e.g., '3 unread notifications') for screen readers and clarity.
